name: Reconciliation
description: Availability-based monthly aggregate only. Months with fewer than five GST registrations and bank accounts without supplied entries are explicit. GST can include inter-registration supplies. Cash/book/tax/scope differences are not receivables or verified unexplained turnover. Party-level GST not supplied.
